description: This file is a makefile fragment for building host tools in a build system, specifically for OpenWrt. It defines build directories, includes other makefiles, sets up build variables, and contains rules for configuring, compiling, installing, and cleaning host build components.

methods.name: Host/Prepare/Default
methods.description: Prepares the source directory for host build, unpacks source if needed, copies source files, and applies patches.

methods.name: Host/Configure/Default
methods.description: Configures the host build environment by running the configure script with specified variables and arguments.

methods.name: Host/Compile/Default
methods.description: Compiles the host build using make with specified jobs and variables.

methods.name: Host/Gnulib/Prepare
methods.description: Prepares Gnulib dependencies for the host build.

methods.name: Host/Build/Core
methods.description: Main build process for host components, including preparation, configuration, compilation, and installation.
